summary: Add GET /api/alerts/trends?days=N to return daily UTC alert-creation counts with severity breakdown for the last N days.

acceptance_criteria.text: GET /api/alerts/trends supports optional days query parameter with default 7 and valid range 1-90, and returns one bucket per UTC calendar day for the last N days (oldest first) with total count plus per-severity counts, including zero-count days and zero-count severities.
Severity count output follows existing severity ordering conventions used by summary behavior (Low, Medium, High, Critical).
Invalid days values (non-numeric or out of range) return HTTP 400 with ValidationProblemDetails, consistent with existing query validation behavior.

constraints: No unrelated refactoring outside trend endpoint scope.
Daily buckets must be based on UTC calendar-day boundaries.
Response must include all days in range and all severities with zero values when no alerts exist.
Severity ordering must remain aligned with existing summary conventions (Low, Medium, High, Critical).
days query validation must use existing API validation style and return ValidationProblemDetails on 400.
coverage_goals: Behavior coverage for endpoint/query validation defaults and range failures (400 ValidationProblemDetails).
Behavior coverage for service/repository trend aggregation by UTC day with oldest-first ordering.
Behavior coverage for zero-filled day and severity buckets and severity output ordering.
